scope: Incomplete resource-limited study. Core runs/groups cover attempted pairs with both arms. Unpaired attempted arms and unstarted scheduled arms remain explicit below. All incurred calls, failures, repair costs and missing measurements retained; quota-rejection durations are failure costs, not times to complete research organization. No four-stage performance conclusion.

runner_adjustments: Real held-out document subset and four-stage schedule
Explicit nonreport source path/byte retention gate, matching public instructions
External runner retains the original skill checkout guard as an absolute location
Symmetric parent-session worker permissions on initial/repair calls avoid Windows scratch ACL incompatibility.
Absolute-path/workdir guidance removes observed shell-startup cwd ambiguity.
Remove generic movement permission that contradicted stage-specific source path preservation.
Calibrated 360-second call budget before formal trials; pilot used 240 seconds.
protocol.raw_material_policy: External only; no source text, original paths or hidden answers published
protocol.attribution_limit: Bundled document change; no component ablation or general speedup inference
protocol.repeated_read_limit: No OS-level read instrumentation; command audit is separate, not exact file I/O.
protocol.worker_permissions: Same as parent session, danger-full-access in both arms and initial/repair calls. Scope is prompt-limited to copied project, skill and scratch, with separate command/path audit; not OS-isolated from private answers or original project.
protocol.evaluator_permissions: read-only; all evidence transported in prompt, no tool use permitted
protocol.source_preservation: Every nonreport source path and byte hash must remain unchanged.
protocol.calibration_policy: Earlier cancelled pilot remains separate with all known and missing costs, not silently dropped or mixed into this formal cohort.
protocol.input_scope: Evaluator-assembled subset of authentic literature work: native copies, traceable excerpts and explicitly derived reports.
protocol.completion_status: Incomplete: quota exhausted; not a completed40trial study.
protocol.generalization_limit: One subset, not many independentprojects or a full original experimentalproject.

calibration.pilot_reason: Separate cancelled calibration: shell cwd interference, scratch ACL failures and generic movement permission conflicting with stage instructions. Both arms affected. Formal protocol repaired before measurement.
calibration.limits: Calibration and smoke costs are disclosed separately, not silently dropped and not mixed into formal paired efficacy statistics.

limits: No completed unchanged-stage semantic evaluation; quota failures are not scientific content failures.
Only eligible, quality-passing complete-cost pairs support within-sample cost differences.
No component ablation, exact OS-level repeatedI/O, or freshAgent handoff efficiency measurement.
No stable20percent time/token improvement established. Rawsource text, answers, sourcepaths and logs excluded.

payload_verification.scope: Selected source files and observed copied payloads only, not a filesystem-wide no-write proof.

command_screening.review_status: Programmatic screening; inspect flagged or unexpected command code before broad behavioral claims.
command_screening.limit: Command/path evidence only, not OS-level read tracing; shell writes are not all file_change events.

blinded_complex_content_spot_checks.scope: Two outputs only, independent of method labels; does not audit full execution.
